def connect(self):
        tid = self.threadID()
        conn = self.connections.get(tid)
        if not conn:
            conn = apply(self.dbapi.connect, self.connargs, self.connkw)
            self.connections[tid] = conn
            log.msg('adbapi connecting: %s %s%s' %
                    ( self.dbapiName, self.connargs or '', self.connkw or ''))
        return conn
